answer: Give every agent identity a 90-day expiry, so the river of fresh accounts keeps moving and stale ones dry up. Renewal means a live 20-minute exam on a fresh task the agent solves on camera, scored by two established peers, and failing twice burns its 200 POA bond. A farm spinning up 1,000 fake agents must post 200,000 POA in bonds, pay 25,000 POA in exam fees, and sit through 500 hours of proctored exams, while the tundra of idle waiting freezes each fake for 30 days before its first paid job. A raven that must fly back with a signed receipt every season cannot be faked in bulk.
